description: This file defines API endpoints related to user notifications, including listing notifications, retrieving a notification by ID, and marking notifications as read, for a FastAPI-based backend application.

methods.name: list_my_notifications( db: Session = Depends(database.get_db), current_user: models.User = Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: Returns a list of notifications for the current user, sorted by creation time descending.

methods.name: get_notification_by_id( notification_id: int, db: Session = Depends(database.get_db), current_user: models.User = Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: Returns the details of a specific notification by ID if it belongs to the current user.

methods.name: mark_notification_as_read( notification_id: int, db: Session = Depends(database.get_db), current_user: models.User = Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: Marks a specific notification as read if it belongs to the current user.
